office ka group insurance hai 4 lakh ka, enough hai

Your 4 lakh cover is part of the employer’s group policy, and the regulator only lets you move that cover into your own name when you leave the group, which means the coverage stays tied to the employer. If you ever decide to get a personal policy, IRDAI's 2020 circular says the move may be subject to underwriting, which means you could face different terms or exclusions. What makes you feel that the current group cover is enough for your needs?
